title: Deliver Wood to Drunfingbridge Paper Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Drunfingbridge Paper Mill** (industry id 7, near tile 97,49).

A likely supplier is **Luntfield Forest** (industry id 2, near tile 79,11); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **650 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
